description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass and a SwiftUI wrapper for displaying a highlighted menu item with hover effects in a macOS application. It manages view layout, mouse tracking, and appearance updates based on hover state.

classes.name: HighlightedMenuItemHostView
classes.description: A custom NSView that hosts an SwiftUI view, manages hover interactions, and highlights the menu item when hovered.

methods.name: init(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Initializes the custom view with a SwiftUI view and specified width.

methods.name: update(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Updates the hosted view and width, refreshing highlight state.

methods.name: updateHighlight()
methods.description: Updates the environment state of the hosted view to reflect hover state and refreshes layout.

methods.name: updateSizing()
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the hosted view and the frame of this view based on the target width.
